lena (devex): Heads-up — after moving packages/sdk/package.json to "type": "module" a bunch of Jest/Vitest tests fail in CI. Looks related to edge mocks and mixed ESM/CJS deps.

ci-bot: [fail] packages/sdk/__tests__/auth-edge.test.ts › should retry on 429
Error: ERR_REQUIRE_ESM: Must use import to load ES Module: node_modules/old-helper/index.cjs
TypeError: Cannot redefine property: fetch

lena (devex): Symptoms summarized:
- Vitest errors with ERR_REQUIRE_ESM when a test indirectly requires a CJS helper from node_modules
- Tests that stub global fetch/crypto sometimes throw "Cannot redefine property" (mocks clobbered between tests)
- Type errors: `Cannot find name 'vi'` after we removed CJS test runner config

rory (sdk): Common mix issue. Quick checklist:
1) Prefer stubbing globalThis (fetch, crypto, TextEncoder) in a setup file instead of mocking modules. Works cross-runner.
2) For CJS-only upstream deps use a tiny CJS test shim (tests/shims/old-helper-shim.cjs) and require() that from tests that need it.
3) Vitest: set `transformMode: { web: [/\.tsx?$/] }` or enable esbuild transforms for TS files.

amanda (eng-runtime): Example setup that avoids redefining globals:
`// tests/setup-edge-globals.js`
`if (!globalThis.fetch) globalThis.fetch = async () => ({ status: 200 });`
`if (!globalThis.crypto) globalThis.crypto = { subtle: { digest: async () => new Uint8Array() } };`
Load via `setupFiles` so each worker gets a fresh copy. Avoid `Object.defineProperty(globalThis, 'fetch', ...)` which fails if already configured.

josh (qa): Repro steps I used: toggle package.json type to module, run `pnpm -w test packages/sdk`. Vitest fails with `ERR_REQUIRE_ESM` for a transitive helper in node_modules. Using a CJS wrapper stopped the error but was awkward to maintain.

rory (sdk): For Jest add an esbuild or babel transform (esbuild-jest / babel-jest) so CJS modules are handled during test runtime. Example jest.config.cjs snippet:
`module.exports = { transform: { '^.+\\.tsx?$': 'esbuild-jest' }, testEnvironment: 'node' }`

lena (devex): Typing fixes: add "types": ["vitest/globals"] to tsconfig.test.json or add `/// <reference types="vitest" />` in top of test files so `vi`/`expect` resolve.

amanda (eng-runtime): Also watch out for test env: Vitest default is node. Our edge-like stubs need web-ish globals; either stub explicitly or use a web-like environment (happy-dom) only if you need DOM APIs.

josh (qa): Suggestion: CI should run two variants: one with `type: module`, another with `type: commonjs` to catch regressions. Also add a tiny integration test that mounts the edge mock setup and verifies fetch/crypto are available.

lena (devex): Plan: I'll open a PR to sdk with:
- tests/setup-edge-globals.js + config for vitest & jest
- small CJS shim pattern for unavoidable CJS deps (kept in tests/shims)
- tsconfig.test.json change adding vitest types
- short doc in devex/TESTING-ESM.md describing transforms and shim recipe

rory (sdk): SGTM. Tag me and amanda. If anyone has a minimal failing snippet (one file + package.json) paste it here and I'll add to the repo as a regression test. :thumbsup:
